scope: Proposition 3.7 (Weak approximation by scalar-near matrices) of the manuscript “Nonuniqueness for bounded measurable scalar conductivities in three dimensions” (preprints/Nonuniqueness-for-Bounded-Measurable-Scalar-Conductivities-in-Three-Dimensions-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 365 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 35017573c88b681f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 13. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Given a subsolution, a weak L2 neighborhood of its pair (E, F), and ε > 0, there is a subsolution in that neighborhood whose matrix has distance less than ε from the scalar matrices outside a set of volume less than ε.
